title: Gurgling Glimmergob
statement: A small, round, faintly translucent cephalopod no bigger than a plum, which sits motionless among smooth black basalt stones and pulses with slow, layered rings of soft blue-green light from somewhere deep inside its body, as though it is quietly thinking in color. The tank around it is dark and still—just those worn stones, a single pale anemone swaying in a barely-there current, and water the blue-black of a sky just after the last star appears.
